MODIFIERSEXPANDED-NEOWS_BLESSING.title: Neow's Blessing
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-NEOWS_BLESSING.descrip: Grants the player their standard Neow's relic reward at the start of a custom run.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-ENCHANTER.title: Enchanter
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-ENCHANTER.description: Card rewards have a random enchantment.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-PHALANX.title: Phalanx
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-PHALANX.description: Enemies gain [gold]Barricade[/gold] and [gold]Plating[/gold] at the start of combat.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-COLORLESS_CARDS.title: Colorless Cards
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-COLORLESS_CARDS.descri: Colorless cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-MARATHON.title: Marathon
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-MARATHON.description: Maps are longer, with fewer rest sites and more elites.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-PAUPER.title: Pauper
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-LONE_WOLF.title: Lone Wolf
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-LONE_WOLF.description: Combat encounters are scaled as if playing with [red]2[/red] players.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-BODY_DOUBLE.title: Body Double
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-BODY_DOUBLE.descriptio: Remove all starting Attacks. Add [blue]1[/blue] upgraded [gold]Body Slam[/gold] with [purple]Clone[/purple]. Attacks cannot be drafted or bought.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-PRAISE_SNECKO.title: Praise Snecko
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-HUBRIS.title: Hubris
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-HUBRIS.description: Start the game with [red]1[/red] max HP.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-POLYMATH.title: Polymath
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-POLYMATH.description: Start the game with the starter relic of all characters.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-EPHEMERAL.title: Ephemeral
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-EPHEMERAL.description: All cards gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. (Does not affect Status, Curse, or Quest cards.)
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CHIMERA.title: Chimera
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CHIMERA.description: Your starting deck is a fusion of all characters.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-RUNIC_DOME.title: Runic Dome
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-RUNIC_DOME.description: Gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy at the start of each turn. You can no longer see enemy Intents.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-URGENCY.title: Urgency
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-URGENCY.description: Every second spent in combat beyond [red]60[/red] seconds deals damage to you.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-URGENCY_PLUS.title: Urgency+
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-URGENCY_PLUS.descripti: Every second spent in combat beyond [red]45[/red] seconds deals damage to you.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-URGENCY_PLUS_PLUS.desc: Every second spent in combat beyond [red]30[/red] seconds deals damage to you.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-SPEEDRUN.title: Speedrun
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-SPEEDRUN.description: If the run timer exceeds [red]40[/red] minutes, you lose.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-SPEEDRUN_PLUS.title: Speedrun+
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-SPEEDRUN_PLUS.descript: If the run timer exceeds [red]30[/red] minutes, you lose.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-SPEEDRUN_PLUS_PLUS.des: If the run timer exceeds [red]20[/red] minutes, you lose.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-RELIC_SWAP.title: Relic Swap
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-RELIC_SWAP.description: Swap your starter relic with a random rare relic.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-HIGH_ROLLER.title: High Roller
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-HIGH_ROLLER.descriptio: Start with [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Jackpot[/gold] and [red]1[/red] [gold]Debt[/gold] in your deck.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-SPRINT.title: Sprint
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-SPRINT.description: The map is a single linear path with [blue]1[/blue] of each room type.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-ENEMY_SCALING.title: Enemy Scaling
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-NEOWS_CONDEMNATION.des: At the start of your run, choose [red]1[/red] of [red]3[/red] negative relics.
